positions.commentary: Older NVIDIA chips are becoming more valuable due to rapid software progress, contrary to depreciation expectations.
Google is running very old TPUs profitably, leveraging older hardware effectively.
Amazon is a major investor in AI infrastructure, deploying capital at scale alongside other tech giants.
Facebook is a large-scale company investing in AI with significant revenue and resources.

thesis: This episode argues that the rapid progress in AI software is increasing the value of older hardware, challenging standard depreciation models. It posits that major tech companies like NVIDIA, Google, and Amazon are successfully leveraging this older infrastructure profitably at scale, while also highlighting the significant revenue and scale of serious AI players like Anthropic and OpenAI.
